# Carina Alves

Carina Alves is the current Deputy of [District 5](https://flow.je/elections/district-5) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). She was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2018.

Carina Alves has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carina-alves#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 42.4% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/carina-alves-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6-PbQw7I1-A)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WF7i1hQ_PI8)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carina-alves#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 5 with 62.7% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/carina-alves/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W247QxogO0Y)

Carina Alves has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 5](https://flow.je/elections/district-5), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/08/assistant-chief-minister-to-seek-re-election/)\]

- Twitter : [@DeputyAlves](https://twitter.com/DeputyAlves)
